Review summary

Based on reviews, created with AI

Reviewers overwhelmingly had a great experience with this company. Customers consistently praise the staff for their professionalism, helpfulness, and friendly approach, making the setup and transition processes smooth and stress-free. Many highlight the exceptional customer service, noting that representatives are always accessible, willing to assist, and provide clear guidance and expertise. The products, particularly the card machines and POS systems, are frequently described as easy to use, efficient, and a significant improvement for businesses. However, some people were dissatisfied with the sales tactics, describing aggressive approaches and feeling pressured. A few other people also felt that the system had limited capabilities for specific business types, like food trucks, and some experienced difficulties with customer service availability or obtaining necessary documentation. Conversely, a small portion of people felt that the product did not work for their needs and encountered issues with returning equipment.

About SkyTab

Written by the company

SkyTab is Shift4's next-gen, all-in-one point of sale and restaurant management platform.

Packed with cutting-edge technology to boost your bottom line and deliver five-star guest experiences — from front-of-house to back-of-house and everything in between, our super-charged tech is ready to serve.  

Features include:  

  • Online ordering
  • Mobile ordering & payments
  • Reservations & waitlist management
  • Customer loyalty program
  • Labor management
  • Reporting & analytics
  • InCharge mobile app
  • Marketing tools
  • Third-party integrations

Karen is fantastic and the deal she got me was perfect

Karen was very patient and answered all my many questions thoroughly and many times over. I had previously been with a card machine supplier that went bust so was looking for two replacement machines for my mobile crêperie business. I had spoken to many sales people who were pushing various deals and so was pretty muddled up by the time I came across Karen. I nearly signed up for a deal elsewhere but the small print was very different from what I had been told by their salesperson. I have previously been caught out by random charges levied by these companies so am very wary.
The deal I got with Karen was way better than SumUp and she also managed to get me two free card machines which work on any network. They actually DO work and were tested thoroughly - I even had a signal in Chichester which is notoriously bad when I had zero phone coverage. The machines are very fast and do provide receipts via email or SMS if needed which is great. I have also chosen to decline accepting AMEX as this costs too much.
Karen has been brilliant throughout and is always checking yo to see how I am getting on. She genuinely cares about her customers and I can see myself working with her for a long time to come. A real breath of fresh air in what is otherwise a very pushy industry! I am more than happy to recommend her to anyone wanting a decent deal with good quality card readers.

I want to share my experience with…

I want to share my experience with Shift4 / SkyTab because it has been one of the most problematic service providers I’ve worked with.

From the beginning, I encountered multiple issues:

1. Incorrect charges, including billing before installation.
Shift4 started charging me before the system was even installed. They also billed me for two printers even though only one was installed. Their own staff confirmed this in person.

2. A two-month delay in delivering the scanner, causing real losses.
The scanner – necessary for locating tickets quickly – took almost two months to arrive. During that time, my staff struggled, lines backed up, mistakes happened during peak hours, and customers were frustrated.

3. A $500 annual fee that was never properly disclosed.
The contract clearly lists a $129.99 annual fee. However, they charged $500 and claimed they “notified” me through a dashboard message.
No written notice was ever sent to my mailing address, my business address, or my email, as required by their own contract.

4. A fraudulent $172.77 online transaction processed entirely by their system.
This was an online order. I never processed the payment or handled the card.
Despite that, they demanded that I provide proof of authorization—when they are the processor and they are the ones who hold the authorization record, AVS, CVV, and transaction logs.
They refused to provide any documentation.

5. Unannounced fee changes and forcing new charges on merchants.
They recently added a new $325 RAF fee per device. I rejected it within the 30-day period the contract requires, yet they are ignoring my notice and insisting I “cannot cancel,” even though the contract clearly allows cancellation without penalty when a new fee is introduced.

6. They do not follow their own contract.
I am exercising my rights exactly as stated in their agreement. Still, they ignore my notices, send generic responses, and act as if I am mistaken simply because the contract clauses that protect the merchant don’t benefit them.

After repeated billing issues, missing equipment, contract violations, lack of transparency, and unfair business practices, I have no choice but to escalate this matter to the Illinois Attorney General, the FTC, and the BBB.
Internal communication with Shift4 has led nowhere. They only enforce contract terms when they benefit the company, and disregard the terms that protect the merchant.

My recommendation to any business considering them:
Do not rely on this company. They do not follow their contract, they don’t provide required documentation, they don’t issue proper notices, and when something harms the merchant, it “applies,” but when something benefits the merchant, they claim it doesn’t count.
